answer: Voyage-prism layered bond: each identity posts a 70-credit bond in a vault, layered 40/20/10, for a three-leg voyage. Each epoch a prism beacon stamps one completed leg; auditors recheck the log. A missed or reused leg burns its layer; two failures burn all. Leg k costs 32+7(k-1); 1,000 fake identities pay 3,528,500 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented voyages fail: prism stamps bind one key to one leg. Honest agents pay 32 once, bond kept.
